name: Surge
description: Produces the headline number. Evening-peak-weighted demand with a genuine step increase on J1's east approach at t=180s. The controller's green extension in response must be an emergent consequence of this real demand (visible in control_decisions), never a demo-only code path.
demand_note: Base flows are evening-peak-weighted (heavier E-W movement) matching the character of simulation/scenarios/demand_profiles.py::EVENING_PEAK, but are hand-authored SUMO <flow> probabilities in corridor_scenario_b_surge.rou.xml rather than programmatically generated from that dict.

scripted_events.description: Real SUMO <flow> demand step-up begins on J1's east approach (vehicles arriving at J1 from J2), live-verified via TraCI to produce a real, measured increase in approach vehicle count/occupancy on E_J2_to_J1_0.
